title: Microsoft Purview: retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory
summary: Hold: the retention automation shown creates a policy but does not set its retention action or duration; a separate retention rule is required. The briefing correctly reports the disagreement between the launched roadmap item and Learn's exclusion of memory from Purview retention. Instructions in the historical verifier comment were ignored and the current page was checked independently.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy opens the relevant Purview retention wizard.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. ... Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration
claims.fix: Extend the static-policy route to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > Microsoft Copilot experiences > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies. The existing route is correct but stops before the location and retention settings.

claims.claim: New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy accepts the printed Name, Applications value and ExchangeLocation All parameters.
claims.quote: "User:M365Copilot,CopilotForSecurity,CopilotinFabricPowerBI,CopilotStudio,CopilotinBusinessApplicationplatformsSales,SQLCopilot" ... The value All for all mailboxes. You can only use this value by itself.

claims.claim: The displayed New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy call is the automation that sets the row's retention control.
claims.quote: Use the New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to create app retention compliance policies. ... After you create the retention policy, use the New-AppRetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to create a retention rule
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api.call and its rendered copy with 'New-AppRetentionComplianceRule -Name "<RuleName>" -Policy "<PolicyName>" -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction <Keep|Delete|KeepAndDelete>' and set api.docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-appretentioncompliancerule. Add to the existing note: 'This sets the retention duration and action on an existing policy; create that policy separately with New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy.' Keep the existing memory-exclusion caveat and policy-creation explanation. The rule reference documents integer days and the three printed action values.
